title: Experimenting with more realistic skin rendering in Three.js. Nami vs Robin, which looks better?
author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on some improvements to skin rendering in img2character, a plugin in my open-source img2threejs ecosystem.

I'm experimenting with how skin materials look under different lighting conditions, trying to make the characters feel a bit more natural in 3D.

For this test, I brought Nami and Nico Robin into the scene. Figured they'd make pretty good test subjects. Haha!

There's still a lot I want to explore, especially around skin shading, lighting, and material details.

I'd love some feedback from both Three.js developers and One Piece fans.

* Which character looks better, Nami or Robin?
* Does the skin rendering feel natural, or is something still off?
* What would you improve next?

This is still an experiment, so any technical feedback is welcome!

Built with Three.js and img2character.

GitHub: [https://github.com/img2threejs/plugin-character](https://github.com/img2threejs/plugin-character)

Unofficial One Piece fan-made showcase.
